scripts.bootstrap: pnpm up && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:migrate:bot && pnpm db:seed
scripts.build: tsc -b && pnpm --filter @blood-connect/doctor-app build && pnpm --filter @blood-connect/admin build && pnpm --filter @blood-connect/centre-app build && pnpm --filter @blood-connect/volunteer-app build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && pnpm --filter @blood-connect/doctor-app typecheck && pnpm --filter @blood-connect/admin typecheck && pnpm --filter @blood-connect/centre-app typecheck && pnpm --filter @blood-connect/volunteer-app typecheck
scripts.boundaries: depcruise packages db --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs && depcruise apps/doctor --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config tsconfig.depcruise-doctor.json && depcruise apps/admin --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config tsconfig.depcruise-admin.json && depcruise apps/centre --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config tsconfig.depcruise-centre.json && depcruise apps/volunteer --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config tsconfig.depcruise-volunteer.json
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm boundaries && pnpm boundaries:prove && pnpm check:bot-migrations && pnpm check:gates && pnpm test
